# Input props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startAdornment` | `ReactNode` | — | Element rendered before the input text (e.g. a search icon). |
| `endAdornment` | `ReactNode` | — | Element rendered after the input text (e.g. a unit label). |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a built-in clear button while the input has text and can be edited: it hides while the input is disabled or read-only, whichever sets it (`disabled`, `readOnly`, or a disabled `Field.Root`). While it shows, it takes the place of `endAdornment`. Clearing empties the input the way typing does: `onChange` and `onValueChange` fire with `""`, so the handler that sets a controlled `value` clears it, and `onClear`, if given, is called afterwards. Focus stays in the input with a mouse click; with the keyboard (Tab to the button, Enter or Space) the input blurs and focus then returns to it. |
| `onClear` | `() => void` | — | Called, with no arguments, when the clear button is used. Passing it also shows the button, as `clearable` does. With `onClear` alone, a controlled input fires no `onChange` or `onValueChange` and keeps its `value` until `onClear` sets it. With `clearable` too, the value handlers fire first and `onClear` only notifies. The button hides while the input is disabled or read-only. Inside a disabled `Field.Root`, it is not called. |
| `labels` | `Partial<InputLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_INPUT_LABELS`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clear` | `string` | `"Clear"` | Name of the built-in clear button. |
